message.content: During batch-size-1 decoding, each new token requires loading the model’s large weight matrices from HBM while performing only a small amount of matrix-vector work. The resulting arithmetic intensity is low, so the number of FLOPs per byte read is far below the GPU’s compute-to-bandwidth ratio. Consequently, the step is limited by how fast weights can be streamed from memory rather than by compute.
